title: Ronaldo Goes the Wrong Way and Instantly Panics
caption: Three “oh no”s before Ronaldo even says what went wrong. Then somebody tells him he can't go back. #StableRonaldo #GTA6 #GTAVI #Gaming
pin: That third “oh no” is when I would've handed somebody else the controller.
why: Rapid-fire panic opens the clip, then a wrong turn and a warning against backtracking leave Ronaldo scrambling.
